meta.parties: Bandara Et Al. v. Dingiri Menika Et Al

rules.statement: A panguwa, free from any liability on the part of nilakarayas to render services or pay commuted dues for over ten years, can be partitioned under the Service Tenures Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "Inasmuch as the land is no longer subject to a liability to perform indivisible services I am of opinion that the learned Judge was right in coming to the conclusion that it could be the subject of a partition action under the Ordinance."
